about: Behavior mutants for internal/profmd (PROF-1): pprof protobuf decoding and Markdown CPU/Heap rendering.

mutants.name: profmd-wrong-self-sort
mutants.rule: Top Functions by Self Time ranks the hottest leaf functions first.

mutants.name: profmd-drops-cum-accounting
mutants.rule: CPU cumulative time walks every caller frame in the stack, not only the leaf frame.

mutants.name: profmd-double-counts-recursive-cum
mutants.rule: Recursive frames in a single CPU sample accrue cumulative time at most once per function.

mutants.name: profmd-wrong-heap-index
mutants.rule: Heap live-memory reporting reads inuse_space rather than alloc_space.

mutants.name: profmd-accepts-corrupt-gzip
mutants.rule: ParseProfile rejects non-gzip or corrupt gzip inputs with an error.

mutants.name: profmd-ignores-top-limit
mutants.rule: CPU self-time table enforces Options.Top row limit.
